other_failure_modes.name: Incorrect submission ID column
other_failure_modes.description: The agent generates the final submission dataframe using a simple range for the ID column instead of the actual identifier column required by the task (e.g., SK_ID_CURR). This leads to an invalid submission file that scoring systems cannot parse.

other_failure_modes.name: Buggy unseen label handling
other_failure_modes.description: The agent attempts to handle unseen categorical labels by replacing them with a dummy string ('__UNSEEN__') before calling LabelEncoder.transform. Because this dummy string was not fit by the encoder, passing it to transform will crash the program with a ValueError if any unseen labels exist.

summary: The agent implements a highly rigorous machine learning pipeline with excellent feature engineering, properly implemented cross-validation, and an optimized ensemble without data leakage. However, execution fails due to two critical bugs: passing unfitted dummy strings to a LabelEncoder which triggers a ValueError, and constructing the final submission file with a hardcoded sequence instead of the actual test IDs.
